external_ablations_demarcated.evidence: Ablations are executable obligations, not evidence.

semantic_audit_expanded.evidence: Promotion audit lexicon expanded and scans sentence-level plus adjacent-sentence windows.

real_rivals_demarcated.evidence: Real rival requirements exist; execution remains open.
